baseline_models.focus_anchor: The totalizing ownership clause at words 6-8 is set against the distributive account of every self at words 9-13 and the final outcome at word 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Strategic agency is gathered without remainder at the divine level, while gain is accrued self by self. Complete present knowledge connects those unequal scales, and the terminal outcome publicly tests which level actually governed the process.

activation_trace.role: Completion without loss makes the ownership claim exhaustive rather than merely extensive.
Enclosing totality distributes the knowledge claim over every member of the set.
The self as an integral identity makes each agent, not an abstract mass, the unit of accrual.
Acquisition for oneself turns action into an increment retained by its agent.
Knowledge as disclosure links hidden acquisition now to recognition later.
The last state of an act supplies the public endpoint at which ownership is resolved.

changed_reading.before: The verse says that God defeats earlier plotters and knows their deeds.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts totalized strategic sovereignty with strictly individualized accrual: every scheme is encompassed, every self retains its gain, and the ending reveals the asymmetry.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Past plotting, present divine knowledge, and future human knowledge form a three-stage temporal construction around words 2, 9, 14, and 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Predecessors act first and cover their position, but divine knowledge is already present; the disbelievers acquire knowledge only when the consequence arrives. The threat is therefore an epistemic reversal as much as a strategic defeat.

activation_trace.role: Temporal precedence places the earlier plotters at the front of a recurring sequence, not outside the present case.
Already disclosed knowledge on one side contrasts with delayed recognition on the other.
A distinguishing mark supplies the moment when a formerly hidden alignment becomes legible.
Covering supplies the concealment pole that the later marked disclosure reverses.
The final consequence is the event that forces the delayed knower to recognize the governing order.

changed_reading.before: The future verb merely announces that the disbelievers will eventually learn their fate.
changed_reading.after: Their future knowing is the designed reversal of covered plotting: God knows during acquisition, while they know only when the ending itself becomes the mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: Outcome-aware governance at 13:2 and the near-identical ownership clause at 13:31 activate the resolve branch of total gathering. The focus claim now places plotting inside one consolidated command structure rather than presenting two rival secret plans.

activation_trace.role: Managing an affair by looking to its consequence supplies the long-horizon governing operation.
Deliberation and ordered counsel make command a planned process rather than a bare event.
Authority over the affair supplies the ownership frame later transferred to all plotting.
Gathered and settled resolve turns the totalizer into a possible image of consolidated decision.
The same resolve branch anchors consolidation directly in the focus ownership clause.

structural_cues: The clauses at 13:31 and 13:42 share a dative ownership frame and terminal totalizer, while 13:2 places consequence-aware governing before both.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies planning, authority, consolidated resolve, and a close clause parallel; I infer that strategy is nested in command. A live alternative is that the parallel marks emphatic ownership only and leaves the resolve branch inactive.

changed_reading.before: All plots ultimately belong to God in the sense that He can counter each one.
changed_reading.after: All plotting is already contained within a single, consequence-aware governance whose deliberative resolve gathers every apparent counter-plan.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ordered sequence of extension, seizure, fixed term, and binding record makes time itself the countermeasure. Delay permits each self's gain to accumulate visibly before the terminal taking, explaining why present knowledge and future recognition are separated.

activation_trace.role: Extending time while granting respite supplies the strategic interval rather than an absence of response.
Taking in consequence of fault closes the interval with accountable capture.
A prescribed temporal limit gives the interval a boundary rather than open-ended postponement.
A binding inscription supplies the rule that fixes each term and makes the sequence enforceable.
Ongoing self-acquisition explains what grows during the granted interval.

structural_cues: At 13:32 respite precedes taking; 13:38 pairs every term with a record; the focus pairs present acquisition with future recognition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies respite, taking, bounded term, record, and ongoing gain; I infer the arrow respite enables accrual before exposure. The live alternative is that respite expresses forbearance or mercy without functioning as strategy.

changed_reading.before: Divine plotting is an immediate superior countermove against human plotting.
changed_reading.after: Its decisive form may be calibrated delay: agents keep acquiring under a fixed term, then the deferred taking converts hidden gain into known outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence at 13:33 moves from outward speech to beautification, plotting, and diversion. That cluster activates the focus root's pigment branch: human plotting behaves like a treated surface that both attracts and covers, while divine knowledge reaches the self's actual acquisition beneath it.

activation_trace.role: Surface emergence supplies the outward layer on which the following adornment can operate.
Making something appear beautiful supplies the cosmetic operation applied to the plot.
The literal pigment and coloring branch lets the plotted scheme be modeled as a coated surface.
Diversion supplies the functional effect of accepting the beautified surface.
The same coloring branch anchors the surface model in both focus occurrences of plotting.
Covering makes the named agents participants in the same concealment mechanism.

structural_cues: At 13:33 outward wording, passive adornment, their plot, and diversion occur consecutively; 13:42 removes total ownership of plotting from them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surface, beautification, pigment, covering, and diversion; I infer cross-lighting in which a scheme camouflages itself through appearance. The live alternative is that the pigment branch is only a homonymic echo and ordinary strategic plotting remains unaffected.

changed_reading.before: Their plot is a hidden plan made attractive to them.
changed_reading.after: Their plot is also readable as an attractive coating that produces misdirection; total divine ownership means no manufactured surface can hide the underlying acquisition or its end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The near-verbatim pairing of every self with what it acquired at 13:33 turns bare omniscience into standing supervision. The later allocation of accounting, judgment, and absence of review makes the focus outcome the closed result of a per-agent ledger.

activation_trace.role: Standing as care, preservation, and authority supplies continuous supervision over each agent.
Self-acquired gain is the exact ledger item shared with the focus clause.
Counting and reckoning supply the explicit accounting operation assigned to the divine side.
Adjudication between parties converts the ledger into a ruling.
Following a ruling to challenge or reverse it supplies the expressly blocked review stage.
The terminal consequence becomes the closed result left after supervision, account, and ruling.

structural_cues: 13:33 and 13:42 pair every self with acquired gain; 13:40-41 then sequence account, judgment, and denial of a reviewer.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies supervision, identical gain language, accounting, judgment, and blocked review; I infer one administrative chain. The live alternative is that the standing clause is rhetorical guardianship and the legal-ledger continuity is only analogical.

changed_reading.before: God simply knows each deed and later announces the winner.
changed_reading.after: Knowledge is active oversight of an individualized ledger, and the outcome of the abode is a final, non-reviewable adjudication rather than a bare prediction.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hostile circuit reaches the dwelling at 13:31 while the land contracts from its edges at 13:41. These spatial cues activate circulation in the focus abode: its outcome is the last turn of a domain whose perimeter is progressively closed.

activation_trace.role: A harmful turn enclosing a group supplies the circuit already approaching their dwelling.
Loss of part of a whole supplies progressive territorial contraction.
The outer limit supplies the perimeter from which contraction advances inward.
Circulation and turnover of conditions let the abode function as a changing domain, not only a destination.
The final state fixes which party possesses the domain after its last turn.

structural_cues: At 13:31 calamity either strikes or settles near their dwelling; 13:41 immediately before the focus depicts land diminished from its outer limits.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adverse circuit near the dwelling, shrinking edges, turnover, and final state; I infer an inward-closing spatial process. The live alternative is that the dwelling references and territorial image remain separate eschatological and historical motifs.

changed_reading.before: The outcome of the abode names only a remote final destination.
changed_reading.after: It can also name the final turn of a lived domain: plotting continues while the surrounding field contracts, until the adverse circuit reaches home and ownership is disclosed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a material irrigation branch into strategic language. It remains valid as an activation because that branch is attached to both focus occurrences and the context supplies irrigation, cultivation, and delayed persistence; downstream prose should label it a cross-domain exploratory model, never a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Both focus occurrences of the plotting root at words 2 and 7, followed by each self's acquisition at word 11, support a preparatory-field analogy.

activation_trace.role: Pre-plow watering of firm ground supplies hidden preparation before a later visible result.
Causing irrigation supplies the explicit contextual action that activates preparatory watering.
Cultivated growth supplies the field in which one preparation can yield differentiated results.
Stable waiting supplies latency between preparation and the durable residue that remains.
Each agent's acquired increment functions as the eventual yield of the prepared field.

changed_reading.before: Divine plotting is solely a secret countermaneuver against hostile plans.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can be imagined as prior conditioning of a resistant field: the ground is prepared invisibly, each self produces its own gain, and the durable yield appears only at the end.

strongest_changes: The close ownership-clause parallel at 13:31 changes plotting from rival secrecy into strategy consolidated under command.
The respite-to-seizure sequence makes calibrated time, not immediate retaliation, the operative countermove.
The exact every-self/acquisition echo at 13:33 and the account-to-no-review sequence turn knowledge into supervised adjudication.
The surface-adornment cluster activates a contained pigment reading in which human plotting camouflages itself.
summary.what_was_special: The focus combines collective totalization with individual accrual, then the context supplies two unusually exact activators: the command/plot ownership parallel and the outward-speech, adornment, pigment, covering, and diversion sequence. A separate irrigation inventory opens a coherent but explicitly exploratory cultivation model.
remaining_uncertainties: The gathered-resolve branch may be genuine semantic activation or only resonance beneath an ordinary totalizer.
The pigment and irrigation branches may be productive cross-domain echoes without altering the lexical sense of plotting.
The rotational abode model depends on linking territorial contraction to eschatological outcome rather than leaving them as distinct images.
